mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, name, avatar, status, must_change_password, login_fail_count, locked_until, data_scope_type, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM sys_internal_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_internal_user SET login_fail_count = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= #{updatedAt} THEN 1 ELSE login_fail_count + 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= #{updatedAt} THEN 1 ELSE login_fail_count + 1 END) >= 5 THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE NULL END, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
